meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会多出两个工具:列出本机 Atomic Chat 桌面应用里可用的模型,以及把提示发给指定模型并拿回回答。Claude 仍负责调度,只是把活分给本地模型。
howto.when: 当你让它用 atomic chat 处理请求时,例如列出本机模型、或让某个本地模型回答问题时,它会调用这两个工具。前提是本机已装 Atomic Chat、本地 API 在 1337 端口开着、并下载了至少一个模型。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
say.note: 它会先列出模型,再生成回答

say.text: 列出 atomic chat 里现在有哪些模型
让 atomic_chat_generate 用某个模型回答:什么是 MCP
say.note: 模型 ID 要和列表里的完全一致

howto.what_en: Adds a stdio MCP server so the agent can call models running in the local Atomic Chat desktop app. Claude still orchestrates but can offload work to local models through two tools.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask the agent to use atomic chat, e.g. list local models or have one answer. Requires Atomic Chat installed with its local API on port 1337 and a model downloaded.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: It lists models first, then generates

say_en.text: List which models are available in atomic chat
Use atomic_chat_generate with a model to answer: what is MCP?
say_en.note: Model ID must match the list exactly
